description.value: Begginnings is a breakfast-forward restaurant established in 2021 in Invermere, BC, whose name cleverly fuses 'beginnings' and 'egg' while paying homage to the pioneer history of the Columbia Valley. It serves high-quality, made-from-scratch breakfast, brunch, and lunch alongside craft beers, handcrafted cocktails, and Prosecco in a vintage-themed dining room that welcomes families and travel groups. A separate lounge with plush seating, world-class espresso pulled by expert baristas, free Wi-Fi, and device charging makes it a natural stop for cyclists wanting to linger and recharge.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website at begginnings.com is active and confirms a real, operating restaurant at 1310 7th Ave, Invermere, BC V0A 1K0, with phone 236-527-2124 matching the OSM record.
